highlights: Settings → Billing has a License for work at a company: 5 to 25 users, in EUR, USD or PLN.
The chat shows the subagents that a Claude or Codex agent starts, with their tasks and steps.
An agent can show its plan before a long task, and the context meter has a New chat button.
Side questions work in the web client and on joined servers.
One server can connect more than one Slack workspace or Discord server, with Discord role limits.
